instantiation_policy.zero_copy_representation: Use np.asarray for y0 without an additional forced copy; pass scalar problem parameters directly after finite-value normalization.
instantiation_policy.contiguous_layout: Use np.ascontiguousarray for the two-state initial vector before solve_ivp.
instantiation_policy.dtype_specialization: Evaluate state/parameter arithmetic in float32 while retaining solve_ivp and returning float64 final values.
instantiation_policy.vectorized_batch_kernel: Use the same FitzHugh-Nagumo RHS with solve_ivp(vectorized=True); the RHS accepts both (2,) and (2,k) states.
instantiation_policy.risk_aware_staging: Use RK45 with rtol equal to one twentieth of the source-visible verifier rtol (5e-7) and keep atol at the verifier/reference 1e-8. No empirical tuning was performed.

implementation_equivalence: Identical operator sets share the exact same Python function across arms; arm labels cannot create timing differences.
